properties.name: P-205 BOUNDARY WATERS CANOE WILDERNESS AREA
properties.remarks:
P-205 
									REGULATIONS REGARDING PROHIBITED AIRSPACE OVER THE
BOUNDARY WATERS CANOE WILDERNESS AREA INMTNNESOTA
Public Law 95-495 incorporated airspace restrictions established by Executive
Order i 0092 that prohibit flights over the Boundary Waters Canoe Wilderness Area.
These areas are depicted on thi s chart as Prohibited Areas P-204, P-205 , and P-206.
In accordance with Executive Order 10092, no person may operate an aircraft below
4,000 feet MSL within the designated areas, except when necessary for:
(1) Making an emergency landing;
(2) Navigating when low-level flight is necessary for safety;
(3) Conducting or assisting in the conduct of official business of the United States,
the State ofMilmesota, or of Cook, SI. Louis, or Lake County, Minnesota; or
(4) Conducting rescue operations.
State: MINNESOTA

P-206 BOUNDARY WATERS CANOE WILDERNESS AREA
properties.remarks:
P-206 
									REGULATIONS REGARDING PROHIBITED AIRSPACE OVER THE
BOUNDARY WATERS CANOE WILDERNESS AREA INMTNNESOTA
Public Law 95-495 incorporated airspace restrictions established by Executive
Order i 0092 that prohibit flights over the Boundary Waters Canoe Wilderness Area.
These areas are depicted on thi s chart as Prohibited Areas P-204, P-205 , and P-206.
In accordance with Executive Order 10092, no person may operate an aircraft below
4,000 feet MSL within the designated areas, except when necessary for:
(1) Making an emergency landing;
(2) Navigating when low-level flight is necessary for safety;
(3) Conducting or assisting in the conduct of official business of the United States,
the State ofMilmesota, or of Cook, SI. Louis, or Lake County, Minnesota; or
(4) Conducting rescue operations.
State: MINNESOTA
